item.title: Breck eyes four-acre former Liverpool sweet factory for affordable homes
item.description: The vacant Valeo Foods factory off Edge Lane would be pulled down and replaced with 69 houses and apartments. The post Breck eyes four-acre former Liverpool sweet factory for affordable homes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Amstone’s £150m Stockport resi due to start this year
item.description: Twelve months on from securing consent for the redevelopment of the former Sainsbury’s on Warren Street, the developer is close to appointing a contractor to deliver the scheme. The post Amstone’s £150m Stockport resi due to start this year appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Placefirst’s Mawson moves upstairs
item.description: The build-to-rent developer and operator’s chief executive David Mawson will become its executive chair in February, sparking the hunt for a successor. The post Placefirst’s Mawson moves upstairs appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Has Manchester lost the plot, or have we just lost the story?
item.description: Manchester is the fastest-growing city-region economy in the UK. This is worth celebrating - but too often our good growth story is drowned out by untruths, writes Lucy Lomas of Luma Marketing. The post Has Manchester lost the plot, or have we just lost the story? appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Cheshire East nods through 400 homes
item.description: With the council’s housing supply placing the committee ‘between a rock and a hard place’ in one member’s words, proposals from Gladman, Richborough and David Wilson Homes can progress. The post Cheshire East nods through 400 homes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Govt unveils social housing reform progress
item.description: Rent convergence, a social housing taskforce, Section 106 changes, a low-interest loan system, and minimum energy efficiency standards were the major headlines behind the Ministry of Housing, Communities, and Local Government’s announcement yesterday. The post Govt unveils social housing reform progress appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Henry Boot delivers ‘resilient’ 2025 performance but warns on 2026 profits
item.description: Results for the year ended 31 December 2025 were supported by strong demand for residential land and the company's focus on streamlining its activities, however the developer has warned that profits in 2026 will fall significantly below market expectations. The post Henry Boot delivers ‘resilient’ 2025 performance but warns on 2026 profits appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: VINCI to deliver £73m+ Marine Lake Events Centre
item.description: Third time’s the charm? Sefton Council has named VINCI Building the preferred contractor for the landmark Southport venue after deals fell through with Kier and GRAHAM last year. The post VINCI to deliver £73m+ Marine Lake Events Centre appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Stockport Homes Group welcomes new chief executive
item.description: Carmel Chambers will step into the top leadership position at the arms-length management organisation next week, taking over the role from the recently retired Helen McHale. The post Stockport Homes Group welcomes new chief executive appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Wirral unveils Riverside Primary School replacement plans
item.description: Morgan Sindall Construction is leading on the project for the council, overseeing the development of a 20,300 sq ft educational facility with library, classrooms, activity hall, and nursery off Brighton Street in Wallasey. The post Wirral unveils Riverside Primary School replacement plans appeared first on Place North West.
